name: standmeet-mail-sender-mcp
description: mail-sender block (JS, cross-platform — replaces the former Go binary): a stdio-MCP server whose send_email tool reaches back to the host over STANDMEET_HOST_SOCKET (supplier.invoke mail/send) to do the actual send. Owns no credentials; recipient is hard-controlled sandbox-side. As JS it cannot import host/Go internals — host-blindness is structural.
